description: Call this before create_monitor. Returns public Monity Network trackers that already check this page the same way (same: follow one instead of creating a monitor; the person gets the same alerts and nobody pays for a second check), and trackers of the same page that check it differently (samePage, with what differs: region, keywords, conditions…). shareable is false for pages that need cookies, headers or actions.

keywords.description: Comma-separated keywords, if the monitor will look for words

name: find_existing_network_watch
title: Find an existing public tracker before creating a monitor
